environment.browser: VS Code integrated browser, Chromium 150.0.7871.250, Electron 43.7.7

workload.sweep: Two cosine-shaped out-and-back cycles across the overflowing hand
workload.offscreenAnimations: Paused with IntersectionObserver and 128px root margin
workload.comparisonSamples: Hidden and animations paused during each run
workload.assets: Decoded before timing; image generation excluded
workload.trials: Two per renderer, second trial reverses renderer order

metrics.taskMs: Delta of CDP Performance TaskDuration, in milliseconds, around the complete run including warm-up and test UI. Main-thread task time, not GPU time.
metrics.styleMs: Delta of CDP Performance RecalcStyleDuration in milliseconds; subset of taskMs.
metrics.mean: Mean requestAnimationFrame interval in milliseconds during the measured sweep.
metrics.p95: Nearest-rank 95th percentile requestAnimationFrame interval in milliseconds.

limitations: This is a preview benchmark of a scrolling hand, not the entire game, SVG depth renderer or landing physics.
No GPU raster/compositing time, energy use or phone performance was measured.
All variants met this desktop's frame budget; no frame-rate improvement is established.
Baked variants use a self-contained static SVG image with foreignObject for browser raster caching, not a generated PNG.
Baked variants retain only a fixed foil pattern and add an approximate normal-blend reflection, not the original independently moving layers.
Rankings can change with viewport, display refresh rate, foil, card count, browser and hardware.
